"'''The Girl and Her Gargantua / The Show Must Go On'''" is the eighth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes" />

==Official description==
''The younglings track an escaped creature. Nash's Jedi friends help reunite her favorite band.''
